verdicts.reason: A breaks up the composition. The green heart ornament is cut off at the top edge, the main cluster is crammed into the top third, and the red monster, ghost and star monster are scattered down the right side with a huge empty area in the lower half. The tree monster's ladder and feet are also cut off at the bottom. B keeps the original arrangement intact, but it is just the landscape design shrunk into a band across the middle of the story canvas, leaving big empty areas above and below. The MERRY/DISCOUNT headline is small at this size and the characters are tiny. B needed rearranging, not shrinking, but it is still far better than A.
